brief.line1: Dormant found 1,485 files worth 109.4 GB it is 96% sure you will not reopen inside 90 days. On the held-out slice it was right 96% of the time it said stop.
brief.line2: At 3.7 GB a week of growth, /demo-boot hits 10 GB free on 2027-01-14. Archiving this list buys you about 208 more days.

snapshot_note: Static capture of the synthetic demo corpus. The live product reads a local SQLite index; this file exists so the dashboard can be shown without a backend.
